Method of Attack: Manifest confusion allowing inconsistency between manifest data and package.json file
Hidden dependencies and install scripts executed during package installation but not visible in npm registry
Cache poisoning, installation of unknown dependencies, execution of unknown scripts, downgrade attacks
Attack Vector: Publishing manipulated manifest data to npm registry with hidden malicious scripts and dependencies in package.json tarball
Indicators of Compromise: Discrepancy between manifest data on npm registry and package.json in tarball
Zero dependencies listed on npm registry while dependencies exist in package.json
